Title: Daikoku Car Meetup Night Tour with JDM Car (Shared Group)
Description:
Tokyo JDM Car Meet & Sightseeing Tour

This tour takes you to Daikoku Parking Area, the most famous and iconic location in Japan’s JDM scene. Along the way, you’ll also visit other must-see car and city landmarks for a complete Tokyo night-drive experience.

Meeting Point
We meet in front of BAR “STAND T”, 1F, 1-5-1 Marunouchi, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo (Tokyo Station).
We will park our cars right in front of the bar.

  • Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays: 6:00 PM
  • Mondays to Thursdays: 7:30 PM

After the tour, you’ll be dropped off at Shimbashi Station.

Tour Schedule

  1. A-PIT Super Autobacs Shinonome – 30 min (Weekdays Only)
    One of the largest car shops in the Tokyo area. Here you can browse a wide variety of car parts, accessories, and souvenirs. Don’t miss the impressive real engines on display. (This stop is not included on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays.)
  2. Daikoku Parking Area – 45 min
    The highlight of the tour. During the day, you’ll see a different atmosphere than the famous night meets — the sunlight shows off every detail of the JDM legends. Depending on the date, weather, and time, you might witness some of the rarest cars in Japan.
  3. Rainbow Bridge – Drive-through, 2 min
    Enjoy the illuminated skyline as we cruise over Rainbow Bridge at night. It’s on the highway, so we can’t stop, but it’s perfect for filming videos from inside the car.
  4. TOKYO TOWER – 15 min
    Capture stunning photos with your favorite JDM cars and the glowing Tokyo Tower in the background.

Notes

  • The car meet at Daikoku Parking may be affected by police closure, weather, and time.
  • Schedule may change depending on traffic and conditions.

Title: Tokyo: Daikoku / Tokyo Highway Exploring Tour (Daytime)
Description: This tour allows you to enjoy lunch at Daikoku Parking, the most famous and most important location in the Japanese JDM scene. First, we stop at APIT, one of the largest car shops in the Tokyo area. Here you can find various car parts and souvenirs. And don't miss the actual engines on display. Next, we head to Daikoku Parking, which looks different from the night. You can see many cool JDM cars in the sunlight of the day. And best of all, you can enjoy the view of many JDM cars from the window while eating lunch, which you can't do at night. You will be able to make lots of memories of JDM. Another advantage of this tour is that you can return to your hotel in the evening, so you will have plenty of time afterwards.

Title: Tokyo Drift Lesson self driving experience JAPAN TRACK
Description:
This is a drift lesson with a professional instructor at Minami Chiba Circuit in Chiba Prefecture, right next to Tokyo.
Even if you have no drifting experience, you will be able to master steady circle driving by the end of the day — all while having fun. Many advanced drifters also join the session, so you can enjoy unlimited side-riding in thrilling chase runs.

Our Drift Tour Car: Toyota Altezza Track Edition
Upgrade Option: For an additional ¥50,000, you can drive a legendary Nissan HCR32 Turbo Track Edition.

All necessary safety equipment for drifting, including helmets, is provided, so you can join casually. Since this takes place on a closed circuit, no license is required.

You will learn from skilled drifters with experience in both Japanese street drifting and circuit racing. In addition to your own lessons, you can ride in the passenger seat of advanced drifters and enjoy chase drifting up close. Once you master your drift by the end of the day, a photographer will capture your best moments.
